research_question: Can an authorized Chinese news cache support traceable local text-tone scores and new-version availability records without claiming a return factor?

sample_selection.jin10_order: received_at ascending, item_key ascending, version ascending
sample_selection.exclude_duplicate: exact normalized original text SHA-256 across the selected sets; preserve excluded IDs and reason
sample_selection.source_rotation: preserve all v4 moomoo versions then earliest eligible Jin10 versions; alternate sources in fixed semantic review selection

scoring.probability_meaning: uncalibrated text-classification outputs, not equity-return probabilities
scoring.long_segment_rule: split on tokenizer-safe character boundaries with complete coverage; never silently truncate
scoring.body_aggregate: arithmetic mean of scored original-text segments; title separate and never double-counted with body
scoring.company_association: only a segment with one explicit verified company alias; multi-company segments retain text tone without company assignment
scoring.event_grouping: exact normalized source title or full text plus source day and claim stage; algorithmic proxy only
scoring.semantic_review_selection: alternate provider then single/multiple/no company and reported/predicted/denied/retrospective, then received_at/article_id; freeze source judgments before model-output read

prospective.start: record actual worker start as separate frozen run receipt before first scoring
prospective.identity: source, article ID, article version, segment rule version, model revision, config SHA-256

factor_candidate.N1: equal-weight mean of direct-company segment tone across distinct algorithmic event groups at frozen company-day snapshot
factor_candidate.N2: count of distinct algorithmic event groups with direct-company evidence
factor_candidate.coverage: observed cache only; no-news cannot be inferred without complete source coverage
factor_candidate.future_primary: one eligible trading session after signal cutoff and actual score availability
